# LineHandleAdornment

- Inherits [`HandleAdornment`](handleadornment.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("LineHandleAdornment")`

A line drawn on a part, from its `CFrame` along its look direction: a pointer, or a path between two places.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.
